scope: Repository prepared X_train/y_train plus X_development/y_development; not the large Drive archives.
user_authorization: User has separate fresh data for testing and requests proceeding without a fixed repository holdout.
repository_role: Walk-forward development; all supplied rows eligible as chronology permits. Original absent purge rows are not reconstructed.
target: Absolute endpoint 48-hour log return in log basis points

validation_policy.purge: Training label_end strictly before first validation decision_time
validation_policy.preprocessing: Fit admission, preprocessing and model using each fold training data only
validation_policy.selection: Repository out-of-fold results may select candidate settings; classify these as development evidence
validation_policy.earlier_validation_rows: May enter later training folds only after their labels mature
validation_policy.retraining: At each of four registered window starts; quarterly through October 2024, with last window extending to latest supplied row.

benchmark_policy.earlier_folds: Refit baseline architecture and training median within each fold; full-training frozen coefficients cannot serve as historical forecasts before their fitting cutoff
benchmark_policy.same_rows: Compare paired losses on identical timestamps
benchmark_policy.historical_MAE_usage: Reference only; not a threshold on a new walk-forward population
benchmark_policy.fresh_test: Evaluate frozen MP0004 and final candidate on identical eligible fresh rows; register any separately refitted comparator before test access

fresh_test.source: User reports separate fresh data; location and dates not yet supplied
fresh_test.use: Final assessment after freezing features, tuning, transformations and evaluation policy
fresh_test.boundary: Verify overlap and label-end separation using metadata before reading outcomes
fresh_test.current_priority: Deferred at user request; not accessed.

compatibility: New experiment protocol supersedes old train/development restrictions for this work only. Original playground CONTRACT.json and scorer remain unchanged; original scoreboard eligibility does not apply to a model trained on former development labels.
next_step: Keep the pair as comparator; diagnose saved out-of-fold errors before registering any further fit-budget extension.
